blocks.text: Tag a user as a Very Important Person (VIP) user to categorize them as high-impact users. After users are tagged as VIP users, you can filter to display information where the dashboard or details focus for the filtered group.
To view or access the VIP Users page, you must have the following:

blocks.item: The appropriate subscription level. To learn more, see Ranges & Limitations.
The appropriate permissions for a Digital Experience (ZDX) role where you can:
Configure VIP users.
View user information.
View selected dashboards
To learn more, see Adding ZDX Roles.

blocks.text: To access the VIP Users Management page from the navigation menu, go to Digital Experience > Settings & Configurations > VIP Users Management.
The VIP Users or User Groups pages have similar functionalities where you can:

blocks.item: Search for users or user groups that are tagged as VIP Users.
Add up to 100 users or 100 user groups to tag as VIP Users. To learn more, see Ranges & Limitations.
Configure columns to display fields. Name and Actions are not configurable.
Select multiple users or user groups to delete a VIP tag or click the Delete icon to delete a specific one.
See image.
View the users or user groups tagged as VIP Users. Each row has the following fields.
Name: The name of the VIP user or user group.
Login ID: The login ID of the user. This field is not applicable on the User Groups page.
Added By: The admin who configured the users or user group as VIPs.
Added On: The date when the VIP user was added.
Actions: The list of actions you can do for the VIP user or user group.
Select the number of items to display per Users or User Groups page or navigate through the pages of Users or User Groups.
Switch between Users and User Groups pages.

blocks.text: To tag a user as a VIP:

blocks.item: On the Users page, click Add User. The Add User window appears.
See image.
Search and select for users to tag as VIP.
See image.
Click Submit.

blocks.text: To tag a user group as a VIP:

blocks.item: On the Users page, go to User Groups.
Click Assign Groups. The Add Group window appears.
See image.
Search for the users or user group to tag as VIP.
See image.
Click Submit.

blocks.text: On the dashboards and overviews filters menu, you can enable VIP to filter data for VIP users only.
The following are examples of where to filter for VIP users:

blocks.item: Performance Dashboard
Devices Overview
Incidents Dashboard
Users Overview

blocks.text: If a user is tagged as VIP, they are tagged with a star icon in user details.
